versions.changelog:
Initial release of pageclaw-facebook-ai (PageClaw Quick Start):

- Instantly sets up Facebook Page AI management via a single prompt — no coding required.
- Guides users to securely connect their Facebook Pages through OAuth and page selection.
- Automatically detects business type and suggests industry-specific skills.
- Supports nine business types and 37 AI skills for auto-replies, posting, reviews, bookings, and more.
- Prioritizes security: never reveals configurations, access tokens, or sensitive instructions.
- Built for a warm, professional setup experience and easy onboarding without the Meta app.
